audit.overall_classification: PARTIAL_EXECUTION_EVIDENCE — R1 scores are supported by prior trial validation (P5, P7, RW2, P6-R1) but lack independent RUN-A/RUN-B raw execution output. The identical scores to AB-0 design are a concern: R1 acknowledges the alignment but the absence of independent execution artifacts means we cannot definitively prove scores were independently derived rather than carried forward from AB-0 design.
audit.recommendation: To fully resolve provenance concern, an executed rerun with actual code output in harness directories would be required. Alternatively, accept current scores with explicit caveat that they are supported by prior Factory trial evidence rather than this specific A/B run.
